events.verdict: Murray (DEN) establishes himself in Pritchard's (BOS) path prior to the contact.
Pritchard (BOS) briefly grasps, and immediately releases, Murray's (DEN) jersey off-ball.
White (BOS) dislodges the ball from Nnaji (DEN) as he defends the shot attempt.  Any ensuing arm contact that occurs after the ball is dislodged is considered incidental.
Walsh (BOS) does not extend his forearm into Nnaji's (DEN) body as he defends the shot.
Brown (BOS) initiates contact with Nnaji's (DEN) arm and affects his shot attempt.
Hauser (BOS) moves into Watson's (DEN) path and delivers contact that affects his SQBR.  This contact causes Watson to step out of bounds during his drive.
Pritchard (BOS) momentarily applies his hand to Murray's (DEN) side before he removes his hand.
Watson (DEN) and Brown (BOS) come together at the same spot and incidental foot to foot contact occurs on the perimeter.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Brown (BOS) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Nuggets.
Walsh (BOS) cleanly ties up Murray (DEN) and a jump ball is correctly called.
Watson (DEN) is moving alongside Pritchard's (BOS) path as he defends the drive.
Watson (DEN) cleanly blocks Walsh's (BOS) shot attempt.
Watson (DEN) initiates contact with Pritchard's (BOS) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Pritchard (BOS) commits a take foul on Watson (DEN).

Murray (DEN) grazes the side of Scheierman's (BOS) head as he passes the ball.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Nnaji (DEN) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Watson (DEN) contests Pritchard's (BOS) shot attempt and the contact after the release is marginal.
Walsh (BOS) commits a take foul on Watson (DEN).
Murray (DEN) legally contests Gonzalez's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Gonzalez (BOS) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Nuggets.
Walsh (BOS) commits a take foul on Watson (DEN).
Watson (DEN) initiates foot to foot contact with Scheierman (BOS) that affects his SQBR.
Braun (DEN) steps inside the 3-pt. line before the release of the free throw.
Scheierman (BOS) breaks the plane of the free throw line before the ball touches the rim.
Scheierman (BOS) commits a take foul on Watson (DEN).
Watson (DEN) is drawn into the air on the pump fake towards Pritchard (BOS) and initiates contact that affects his jump shot attempt.
Gonzalez (BOS) commits a take foul on Murray (DEN).
